newsitem.title: INDIA: Steel, carmaker shares push Delhi bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Steel, carmaker shares push Delhi bourse higher.

text.p: Foreign buying in automobile and steel shares lifted Delhi share prices to a moderately stronger close on Wednesday, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 1.07 points higher at 910.35.
The index had spurted to 918.53 in late afternoon trade before profit-taking trimmed the gains.
"The diversion of funds from the bullion market towards the secondary market was another positive factor behind the current bull run in stock prices," said Bharat Bhushan of brokers Nu-Era Equities.
Steel maker TISCO ended 3.30 rupees higher at 207.80 on sustained buying by foreign institutional investors, fuelled by reports the company has increased its steel prices, brokers said.
Hero Honda surged 27.00 rupees to 530.50 on foreign buying.
Bajaj Auto rose 26.00 rupees to 950.00 and LML firmed 1.65 rupees to 58.65.
Reliance Industries slipped 4.50 rupees to 366.00 on profit-taking by speculators.
State Bank of India fell 6.60 rupees to 348.25.
